model.name: serverPath.assertComputeScaleInvariant
model.description: For each per-request response path: assert server compute is O(children)/O(1) not O(total-units) by measuring compute-vs-corpus (scale the corpus, path stays flat); route reads through ONE shared warm ScenarioIndex + cached CR reverse-index (no new-per-request); latency bound achievable (~100-150ms, RTT floor ~80ms) at representative corpus. Discovered by measuring, never a line-list.
model.note: Architect wires Class (shared warm ScenarioIndex + CR reverse-index) + Method + the scale-probe gate on build-go, then re-inspects. DO-NOT-BUILD until scheduled.
